definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese board game where players roll dice and move pieces along a path, often played during New Year celebrations.

examples.english: We played sugoroku as a family during New Year's.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{双六|すごろく} is a traditional Japanese game, especially popular during the New Year (⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧). Modern versions often have themed boards with illustrations.

TYPES:
- {絵双六|えすごろく} (illustrated sugoroku - most common today)
- {盤双六|ばんすごろく} (board sugoroku - older version similar to backgammon)

GAMEPLAY:
Players take turns rolling dice (⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧) and move their pieces along the board. Landing on certain spaces may advance or set back the player. The first to reach the goal (⟦{上|あ}がり→上がり：25038_agari⟧) wins.

NEW YEAR GAMES:
Sugoroku is one of the traditional New Year games along with:
- ⟦{凧揚|たこあ}げ→凧揚げ：07128_takoage⟧ (kite flying)
- ⟦{羽根|はね}つき→羽根つき：07129_hanetsuki⟧ (Japanese badminton)
- ⟦かるた→かるた：21979_karuta⟧ (karuta cards)
